name: formio-ai
description: Form.io MCP server + skill library. Bundles the Form.io MCP server and a skill library covering every endpoint in the Form.io API, plus form JSON schema guidance for generating and editing Form.io forms and resources.

formio_base_url.title: Form.io base URL
formio_base_url.description: Base URL of your Form.io deployment (e.g. https://api.form.io for Form.io SaaS, or your self-hosted host). Used as the parent of FORMIO_PROJECT_URL.

formio_default_project_url.title: Form.io default project URL (override per directory with project_set tool)
formio_default_project_url.description: Full URL of the default Form.io project the MCP server should target (e.g. https://api.form.io/my-project). Acts as the initial value on first run in a directory; once you call project_set there, the chosen URL is persisted to ~/.formio/projects.json for that directory and overrides this default in future sessions.
